jobs.occupation: Managing Consultant Global IT Vendor Management (m/f/d) (Global-Sourcing-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Introduction/About us

Group IT Strategy, Sourcing & Transformation shapes and supports the execution of the One IT vision across Fresenius. The department brings together IT procurement, strategic sourcing, vendor management, enterprise architecture, IT governance and service management to strengthen collaboration, ensure compliance and harmonize IT processes across the Group.

We are looking for an experienced Managing Consultant for Global IT Vendor Management (m/f/d) to lead the strategy, governance, commercial performance and executive relationships for selected strategic IT vendors. In this role, you will help protect contractual value, improve supplier performance, coordinate commercial and third-party risks, and ensure that strategic vendor relationships deliver measurable and sustainable business outcomes.

Your responsibilities

- Vendor strategy: Develop and maintain short- and long-term strategies for assigned strategic IT vendors, with measurable objectives covering cost optimization, service performance, technology adoption, innovation, contractual protection, flexibility and overall value.
- Contract lifecycle: Coordinate contractual obligations, commercial milestones, amendments, change orders, renewals, termination planning and exit readiness. Maintain a forward-looking renewal pipeline and ensure that contractual decisions receive the approvals and signatures required under applicable company policies.
- Commercial governance: Monitor spend, consumption, commitments, pricing mechanisms, indexation, credits, penalties, caps, thresholds and other contractual levers. Identify potential commercial leakage and optimization opportunities and coordinate approved actions with Finance, Procurement, product owners and vendors.
- Vendor performance: Establish and operate vendor scorecards covering service, commercial, financial, risk, innovation and stakeholder dimensions. Validate performance information, identify root causes and trends, and coordinate corrective and continuous-improvement plans.
- Governance: Design and facilitate strategic, tactical and operational governance forums with appropriate participants, decision rights, escalation paths, agendas, cadence and documented actions. Lead executive Quarterly Business Reviews and track agreed commitments through to closure.
- Sourcing and negotiations: Partner with Strategic Sourcing, Procurement, Legal and other relevant functions on sourcing events, renewals and complex negotiations. Conduct market analysis, benchmarking and commercial scenario modelling and prepare decision-ready business cases for the applicable approval bodies.
- Third-party risk: Maintain a consolidated view of vendor-related risks and coordinate assessments, reporting and remediation with accountable functions such as Information Security, Data Protection, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Procurement and Business Continuity. Escalate material risks through the applicable governance channels.
- Stakeholder relationships: Act as a primary commercial and governance interface between assigned strategic vendors and internal stakeholders. Facilitate cross-functional decisions, manage escalations and translate complex commercial, performance and risk matters into clear recommendations.

Your qualifications

- Substantial relevant experience in strategic IT vendor management, technology sourcing, contract and commercial management, procurement or a comparable supplier-governance role in a complex international organization.
- Demonstrated experience managing complex and strategically important IT contracts or vendor portfolios, including commercial governance, service levels, contractual obligations, renewals, disputes and exit provisions.
- Strong commercial and contractual expertise, including negotiation, benchmarking, business-case development, cost optimization and the application of contractual value levers.
- Experience establishing and operating vendor-performance and governance frameworks, including scorecards, KPIs, SLAs, executive reviews, improvement plans and escalation processes.
- A sound understanding of third-party risk management, including supplier due diligence, information security, data protection, compliance, financial risk and operational resilience.
- Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a matrix organization, influence senior internal and supplier stakeholders, resolve complex escalations and facilitate decisions without relying on direct authority.
- Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to interpret commercial, financial, performance and risk information and present clear recommendations to senior stakeholders.
- Business-fluent English, required for global stakeholder and vendor engagement. German language skills are an advantage for collaborating with stakeholders based in Germany.

What we offer

Shape strategic technology partnerships that deliver measurable value, resilient services and controlled risk across Fresenius — join #futurefresenius and make an impact!

Contact

Apply now through our online portal to submit your application.

About us

Job description

In order to support the integration of AI in Operations Investment decisions, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Master student (d/f/m) in the field of Investment Management

title of thesis: Generative AI & Process Automation in Industrial & Strategic Investment/CapEx Decisions

You are looking for a master thesis and want to get to know the work of an Investment Manager in Industrial Operations? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the central Capex Management department as a master student (d/f/m)!

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: Q1 2027
- Duration: 6 months

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Your benefits

- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

As-Is Process Mapping:

- Assess the current state of the end-to-end CapEx dossier creation lifecycle across operational sites. You will have a close exchange with the results of the VS (Value Stream Assessments) results.

Optimisation Analysis:

- Pinpoint bottlenecks, redundant reporting between local presentations and our enterprise CapEx Planning Tool (CPT), and root causes in heavy 27-slide dossiers

Solution Design:

- Outline proposed improvements by architecting an intake and generation pipeline connecting Google Drive, Gemini AI, and Google Slides to condense content into a decision-oriented 7-slide format and and integrate “investment intelligence”, e.g. benchmarking or cost referentials.
- Design, test, and calibrate prompt or similar tools workflows for Gemini to synthesize executive summaries, risk matrices, and multi-year cash phasing projections.

Pilot Case:

- Test your approach by running 1 to 3 live industrial investment dossiers through the automated pipeline.

Performance Comparison & AI Compliance:

- Evaluate KPI improvements (As-Is vs. To-Be), measuring administrative time savings and controller approval speeds and general compliance.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled fulltime in the final year of a Master’s degree (Bac+5 / MSc) in Industrial Engineering, Information Systems (with strong business/operations interest), Business Analytics, Data Science, or a related dual engineering/business program.
- Technical Mindset: Strong interest in Generative AI prompting, workflow automation, and low-code integration (e.g., Google Workspace ecosystem, Apps Script / Python, API interactions).
- Business & Financial Curiosity: Comfortable understanding operational investment concepts (CapEx vs. OpEx, cash phasing, business cases, ROI/NPV logic).
- Communication & Change Leadership: Strong interpersonal skills to interface smoothly with diverse stakeholders (from shop-floor industrial engineers to financial controllers).
- Language Proficiency: Negotiation-level fluency in English (working language). Knowledge of French, German, or Spanish is an asset.

About Allianz Global Investors

Allianz Global Investors is a leading active asset manager, managing assets for individuals, families, and institutions worldwide. Our shared goal to shape a future of opportunity for our clients is foundational to our culture and our values. We look to attract, and actively nurture, individuals with the drive to achieve excellence at every stage of the investment experience.

We believe an inclusive culture is key to a flourishing workforce. Not only do we celebrate the broad range of experiences, backgrounds, and attributes that our workforce brings, but we support our people to live and work in a way that promotes their own wellbeing.

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer.  

We are united by a shared commitment: to put our clients first and at the centre of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions.  

Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future - for our clients and for the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. The foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and where integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust are at the heart of our culture.  

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations. 

If you feel inspired to promote the active asset management experience, this is the place for you. Join our international, technology-enabled, and agile environment. Simply upload your CV in English to apply for this position.  If you need support to navigate our websites or at any stage during your application, please send an email with your request to recruiting@allianzgi.com. 

To Recruitment Agencies:

Allianz Global Investors has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz Global Investors does not accept unsolicited resumes from agency or search firm recruiters.

When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. Fees will only be paid when there is a contract in place.

Without a contract in place, we will not accept invoices on unsolicited resumes, even if the candidate was ultimately employed by Allianz Global Investors.

Finally, please do not contact hiring managers directly.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

How to Apply: Applying is quick and easy. Simply upload your CV, complete your personal details, confirm your consent for AI support in the "Additional Information" section, and submit your application.

To support our recruiters, we use Fit Score—an AI‑powered tool that highlights how closely your profile aligns with the role. This helps us review applications more efficiently and focus on what matters most: your skills and experience.

Good to know: The Fit Score is a support tool only. At Allianz, technology never replaces human judgment. Every application is carefully reviewed by our recruiting teams, ensuring a fair, thoughtful, and personal hiring process.
